summary: Headlights, tail lights and low-beam cones of simulated cars, trucks and buses. No new dataset: every lighting value is an estimate; vehicle positions come from the simulation.

inputs.name: Vehicle poses
inputs.source: norrkoping-simulator-backend simulation (SSE snapshot), smoothed per frame by src/lib/transportModels.ts and src/lib/publicTransport.ts

inputs.name: Lamp positions on the vehicle models
inputs.source: the drawn models in src/lib/transportModels.ts (compact, estate, truck) and src/lib/publicTransport.ts (bus)
inputs.accuracy: matches the drawn lenses (±0.05 m); the models themselves are generic, not specific vehicle makes

estimates.name: BEAM_CANDELA
estimates.basis: typical order of magnitude of a dipped-beam hot spot (about 2 × 15 000 cd); no vehicle model, no regulation table, no compliance claimed
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: BEAM_SHAPE
estimates.basis: generic European dipped-beam pattern (sharp cut-off just above the horizontal, wide spread, little light right in front of the bumper); symmetric (no kerb-side step)
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: BEAM_RANGE_M
estimates.basis: smooth range window; typical useful reach of dipped beams
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: BEAM_COLOR
estimates.basis: neutral-warm white between halogen and LED headlamps
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: Display calibration
estimates.value: STREET_LUX_SCALE 0.035 per lux (the existing street-light calibration, unchanged)
estimates.label: perceptual calibration

estimates.name: Lens glow
estimates.unit: emissive intensity added at full night (day values unchanged: cars/trucks 0.4, bus 0.5 / 0.3)
estimates.label: perceptual calibration

estimates.name: Selection
estimates.basis: performance budget (shader loop) and visibility; not a property of real vehicles
estimates.label: rendering budget

switching: Lights follow the street-lighting night level env.artificial (1 − smoothstep(−3°, 2°, solar elevation)). Real vehicles in Sweden drive with dipped beams or daytime running lights at all times (Trafikförordningen); the day state here shows no beam, as specified for F1.
coordinates: Scene units, x east, z south, 25 m per unit × grid scale factor 0.9996584126, origin E 569030 / N 6494989 (EPSG:3006, SCENE_REFERENCE); heights relative to the rendered RH2000-based ground. Vehicle heading 0 points along +z (scene south); forward = (sin h, cos h).
